svg.aria-label: PR Board in a browser, light theme, on the fictional demo organization: a command bar with the search and the counters 12 ready, 16 missing, 15 approve and 3 drafts, above the filter bar; a To review group lists 4 teammates' PRs that ask for your review; then one group per category, its heading with a bar of its status mix, and one row per PR with a coloured left bar, the number, the title, the repository, branch and signal chips under it, and the next step as a chip on the right: solid when it is your move, outlined on a faded row when you wait. A PR that waits on another sits under it.
